From Digital Nomad to One-Person-Company Founder

October 6, 2026 · CCTV (中央电视台) — 读懂中国 · Understanding China

China’s national state broadcaster, CCTV, profiled Rob Moya in the Understanding China · My China Story (读懂中国 · 我的中国故事) segment — the story of a Costa Rican software developer who traveled the world as a “digital nomad” and, in May 2026, received the first foreigner OPC (one-person company) business license in Suzhou Industrial Park.

The segment aired on CCTV-4 国际时讯 on October 6, 2026 at 22:45 (runtime 05:53) and was syndicated through CCTV News mobile and WeChat. It follows Rob from a career of remote work for foreign companies to founding a software business in Suzhou — building platforms and applications that companies and individuals ask him to design.

Rob is currently developing a real-estate information platform that lets company owners manage property brokers and publish listings across 小红书 (Xiaohongshu), WeChat, and Facebook. His message to founders hesitating to come to China: “If you’re a foreigner considering coming to China, don’t wait — just come. Five or ten years from now, your life could be truly different.”

The piece highlights what Rob calls China’s most underrated advantage: AI. He uses Chinese AI platforms and models in his daily work — Alibaba’s AI models, DeepSeek, Zhipu’s GLM, and ByteDance’s Seedream and Seedance for image and video generation. “In Latin America, people don’t know these yet,” he says. “I want to show them there are other options — ones that may be cheaper and more powerful.”

He is actively urging Latin American startup founders to build with Chinese technology, and notes how China’s modernization is felt in daily life — from AI tutoring platforms used by schoolchildren to technology adopted within the same month it appears. Registering his company took “just two weeks,” compared with one or two months in his home country. “China has all the advantages — I can keep doing business while enjoying a very peaceful lifestyle,” he says. “China is already the best partner. If you try, you will likely succeed.”

The CCTV feature is a landmark for the one-person company model and for the Moon Bay · Overseas Talent OPC Entrepreneurship Community, which guided Rob through the first-ever foreigner OPC registration in the park — proof that China’s newest company structure is ready for a global audience.
